entries.subject: Temperature map at 15 um from ten JWST MIRI visits
entries.finding: The lens. Ten MIRI/F1500W visits (program 3077's phase curve, 1177 observations 7-11, 2304 observations 1-4) reduced from raw on Bell's settings with a fractional-pixel aperture, fitted jointly with his model, and b's emission mapped with the repository's eigenmap fit. The joint fit gives a dayside of 859 ppm against Bell's 797 +/- 77. The hot-spot offset is not measured: free it goes to 28 deg west, but a centred map is 1 in log-likelihood worse and the offset trades against the Gaussian process for the star, so the map is symmetric about the star-facing point (degree 2, one eigencurve by BIC): 519 K there, 463 K and 243 K day and night hemisphere averages. North-south structure is not measured.
